mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and thus drives S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the specified horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 50-period moving average signals increased supply and productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If industrial production rises but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE) combined with high employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives S&P 500 returns higher over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both unemployment is low and employment is high but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases borrowing costs, reducing corporate investments and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If federal funds rate is high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, boosting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both housing starts and retail sales increase but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, increasing consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If unemployment is low but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both industrial production and GDP grow but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressures, leading to potential monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPI is high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
